title: MegaMUD Provenance Audit
finding: No original MegaMUD master source/config file containing CommandDelay, CombatPulse, or TickSyncBuffer was found in the available repository tree during this pass.
observed_absences: No MegaMUD.ini with CommandDelay/CombatPulse/TickSyncBuffer found in current repo tree
No exact CommandDelay/CombatPulse/TickSyncBuffer string found outside prior user-provided excerpt/report text
MMUD Explorer uses ROUND_SECS = 5 in its exp/hour model documentation, conflicting with simple 1.5-second combat-pulse interpretation
interpretation: MegaMUD timing constants remain evidence candidates until original-file provenance is located. The imported MegaMudMP path files are useful client/pathing evidence but do not prove terminal timing settings.
promotion_decision: No timing constants promoted from MegaMUD evidence in 0086.
